name: ListColumn
description: Represents a column in a table.
remarks: The ListColumn object is a member of the ListColumns collection. The ListColumns collection contains all the columns in a table. Use the ListColumns property of the ListObject object to return a ListColumns collection.
example:
Sub AddListColumn()
 Dim wrksht As Worksheet
 Dim objListCol As ListColumn

 Set wrksht = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets("Sheet1")
 Set objListCol = wrksht.ListObjects(1).ListColumns.Add
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the ListColumn object within the ListColumns collection.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name of the list column.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range to which the specified list object applies.

properties.name: TotalsCalculation
properties.description: Determines the type of calculation in the Totals row of the list column based on the value of the XlTotalsCalculation enumeration. Read/write.

properties.name: XPath
properties.description: Returns an XPath object that represents the XPath of the element mapped to the specified Range object. The context of the range determines whether the action succeeds or returns an empty object. Read-only.

properties.name: DataBodyRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that is the size of the data portion of a column. Read-only.

properties.name: Total
properties.description: Returns the Total row for a ListColumn object. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the column of data in the list.
